lines.hello1: Hi! I'm Dot. This is my garden.
lines.hello2: Can you tap me, to say hello?
lines.tickle: Hee hee! That tickles! Hello, friend!
lines.v1: Ooh, look! A visitor. One ladybird.
lines.v2: Another one! Now there are two ladybirds.
lines.count_intro: Let's count them together. Watch me first.
lines.now_you: Now you! Tap the next ladybird.

already.text: Hee hee, you already counted me!

lines.tap_hint: Tap a ladybird that isn't shiny yet.
lines.round2: Oh! Another ladybird has come to play. Can you count them all, from the start?
lines.total4: Four! There are four ladybirds. Well done!

sad1.text: Oh, hello. I've lost all my spots. Can you give me two spots, please?

drag_demo.text: Pick up a spot, and put it on my back. Like this.

drag_hint.text: Drag a spot onto my back.

sad2.text: Can you help me too? I need three spots, please.

thanks3.text: Three spots! I love them! Thank you!

lines.bye1: Look! The ladybirds are flying to your garden.
lines.bye2: You helped me so much today. See you tomorrow!
lines.play_again: Do you want to play again?
